summary: Frontend-only testing of guided practice voice controls fix. Verified that 'Play Voice Guidance' and 'Tap to Retry Voice' buttons are visible and functional in GuidedPracticeOverlay on both Sacred Ally Alchemy and Angelic Alchemy pages. No regressions detected in play/pause, mute, exit, or timer functionality.
